question.problem:
Consider the following partitions:

- ${P}_{1}=\{{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}\}$ is a partition of the interval $[1,5]$

- ${P}_{2}=\{{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}\}$ is a partition of the interval $[5,7]$

Calculate ${\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j},$ where $Δ{x}_{i}={x}_{i}-{x}_{i-1}$ and $Δ{y}_{j}={y}_{j}-{y}_{j-1}.$
question.worked_solution:
Using the product rule, we can write the summation as

$$
{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}Δ{x}_{i}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}.
$$

Note that ${\sum }_{i=1}^{m}Δ{x}_{i}$ and ${\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}$ are just the lengths of the intervals $[1,5]$ and $[5,7]$ respectively. So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}Δ{x}_{i} & =5-1=4, \\ {\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j} & =7-5=2.\end{aligned}
$$

Combining our results, we have

$$
{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}Δ{x}_{i}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}=4\cdot 2=8.
$$
